complexity.notes: Using mid = start + (end - start) // 2 and a half-open interval is clean and avoids off-by-one errors; the empty-array case is also handled correctly by the start == end check.
complexity.summary: Classic iterative binary search over the half-open interval [start, end), narrowing the range each iteration and returning the index on equality; after the loop at most one candidate remains and it is checked explicitly. The final guard handles both the exhausted (start == end) case and a lone non-matching element.
